issues.on_page: User fees 2,314,079 (Electric 1,738,240, Water 200,022, Sewer 198,137, Other Enterprise/Sanitation 177,680)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Utility Charges] These are utility fund sales (electric, water, sewer and sanitation). The user rule (2026-10-28) makes them category Utility Charges, out of charges for services. The same label's detail lines (Electric/Water/Sewer) already carry Utility Charges, so the report is also inconsistent with itself.

[fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Utility Charges] This is an electric fund sale, so the user rule gives Utility Charges. The matching detail line (Electric Fund Bulk power sales) is already Utility Charges.

issues.on_page: Other Enterprise: User fees 177,680 (p2: Sanitation charges 178,738)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Utility Charges, detail_category refuse/sanitation charges] The Other Enterprise column is sanitation (p2), so these are garbage/refuse charges, which the user rule puts in Utility Charges. The other three User fees detail lines are Utility Charges.

issues.on_page: Grants and donations 594,305 (p2: operating grants 59,683 + capital grants 534,622; 553,137 is in the Local Option Sales Tax fund)
issues.issue: Mixed grants and donations line with no stated source. The large capital grant for the public welfare project (529,887) may be government money. This is already in decision_needed.

issues.on_page: Capital contributions (27,625) + Proceeds from sale 1,293; total other financing sources (uses) (26,332)
issues.issue: p2 labels the (27,625) 'Contributions - internal activities', and it matches business-type Capital contributions (net) +27,625 on p6. It is an internal transfer between governmental and business-type activities and arguably belongs in transfers_out / business_type.transfers_net. The arithmetic and computed marking are correct.
The amount matches the page. It is the business-type side of the internal contribution from governmental funds (p2), so it is arguably transfers_net rather than other_financing.

issues.on_page: Electric: Utilities 1,133,832 (62% of electric operating revenue)
issues.issue: In the electric fund, a 1.13M 'Utilities' line is almost certainly wholesale purchased power (purchased power/cost of sales), not utility bills. It was kept as printed because the label doesn't say so.

[fixed 2026-10-28: review note added to disbursements[16] and detail[96]] Category 'other' (and detail[96] 'miscellaneous expenditure') carries no review note, although the rules require one for last-resort categories. The line names a funding source, not an object.

issues.on_page: Local Option Sales Tax fund: Taxes 164,668
issues.issue: The fund name says these are local option sales tax receipts, but the page doesn't print a breakdown, so taxes (unlabeled) is defensible. sales tax looks likely.

issues.on_page: Certificates of deposit 499,331 (inside Total assets / fund balances 2,441,972)
issues.issue: ending_cash 2,441,972 already includes the certificates of deposit. ending_investments is informational, and anything that adds it to cash will count it twice.
Category is a guess. Infrastructure studies could equally be streets/highways or economic development.
